intro: People to People Health Foundation is a Section 8 company (Non-Profit) founded in the year 2016, with the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA), GOI, under the Companies Act 2013.

vmv.title: Vision
vmv.text: We envision a world where everyone has equal access to opportunities for better health.

vmv.title: Mission
vmv.text: Transforming lives for improved health and well-being through locally driven solutions.

vmv.title: Values
vmv.text: Stewardship to fulfill our commitment to make a positive impact. Accountability for our work and results. We do more because we collaborate. We strive constantly to innovate
